angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 33,723,362 km at 93.02 pc = 4.85 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 40526: distance 93.023 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.018), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 93.023 +/- 1.674 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 10.1026 +/- 0.3141 mas (same row, RUWE 2.95), 32.2 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 48.474 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 40526: radius 48.474 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 598.297 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.063) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 33,723,362 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4103 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 40526: effective temperature 4103 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.076) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 40526: effective temperature 4103 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.076) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433)
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of bet Cnc (pscomppars): spectral type K4 III, from Lee et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...566A..67L/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of bet Cnc (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.29 dex, from Lee et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...566A..67L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of bet Cnc (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 2.9, from Lee et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...566A..67L/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of bet Cnc (pscomppars): age 1.85 Gyr, from Lee et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...566A..67L/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of bet Cnc (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.7 km/s, from Lee et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...566A..67L/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's measured spectrum (Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1)) (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.

surfaceGravitySource: log g 1.28 from 2024A&A...682A.145S; the 19 published values span log g 0.98 to 2.05, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.2% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A%26A...682A.145S)
